What are the mean and the variance of $X$?

questions.question_text:
A fair coin is tossed $100$ times and $X$ is the number of heads.
What is $\sigma(X)$?

options.why: Gave the variance $np(1-p)$ instead of taking its square root.
Multiplied the single-trial standard deviation $0.5$ by $n=100$; standard deviation is not multiplied by $n$.
Took the square root of the mean $np=50$ instead of the square root of the variance.

questions.solution_text:
Success: the coin shows a head.
$X\sim\mathrm{Bin}(100,0.5)$
$\mathrm{Var}(X)=100\times0.5\times0.5$
$=25$
$\sigma(X)=\sqrt{25}$
$=5$
